title: Pixel Warp
description: Advanced Minecraft warp management plugin featuring GUI navigation, smart teleportation, analytics, encrypted storage, backups, and FILE/MySQL support.
body:
# Pixel Warp

Pixel Warp is a modern warp management plugin designed for SMPs, community servers, and large Minecraft networks. It provides a complete warp system with GUI navigation, smart teleportation, access control, analytics, backup tools, and flexible storage options.

Unlike traditional warp plugins that only provide basic teleportation commands, Pixel Warp focuses on reliability, security, performance, and long-term data safety.

## Features

### Warp Management

* Create and manage public warps
* Private warps with player access sharing
* Warp categories and organization
* Warp renaming and editing
* Safe warp deletion with confirmation

### GUI Navigation

* User-friendly warp browser
* Pagination support
* Warp search functionality
* Category filtering
* Sorting options

### Smart Teleportation

* Teleport countdown system
* BossBar progress display
* Movement cancel protection
* Safe teleport validation
* Teleport particle effects
* Arrival burst animations

### Warp Preview System

Preview a warp before teleporting.

* Spectator preview mode
* Automatic return system
* Original location restoration
* Gamemode restoration

### Access Control

* Private warp sharing
* Offline player support
* UUID-based permissions
* Global administrator override system

### Analytics

Track warp activity across your server.

* Warp usage statistics
* Last-used tracking
* Most popular warp rankings

### Storage Options

Pixel Warp supports multiple storage backends.

#### FILE Storage (Default)

* No database required
* Easy setup
* Encrypted local storage

#### MySQL Storage (Optional)

* Suitable for advanced server setups
* Centralized storage support
* Migration tools included

### Backup & Recovery

* Manual backups
* Backup restoration
* Recovery assistance tools
* Migration support

### Security & Data Protection

Pixel Warp includes multiple protection systems designed to reduce the risk of data loss.

* AES encrypted storage
* Config validation
* Safe migration handling
* Corruption recovery support
* Read-only recovery mode
* Async write protection
* Data integrity verification
* Safe reload system
* Confirmation for destructive actions

### Performance Optimizations

Built with performance in mind.

* Async storage operations
* In-memory caching
* Cache-first architecture
* Distance-based particle rendering
* Nearby-player particle visibility checks
* Configurable particle intervals
* Optimized particle engine

## Why Choose Pixel Warp?

Pixel Warp is designed for server owners who want more than a basic warp plugin.

Key advantages include:

* Public and private warp support
* GUI-based navigation
* Warp preview functionality
* Built-in analytics
* Dual storage architecture
* Optional MySQL support
* Encrypted file storage
* Backup and recovery systems
* Advanced access control
* Performance-focused design
* Modern modular architecture

Whether you run a small SMP or a growing community server, Pixel Warp provides a scalable and reliable solution for managing player destinations.

## Requirements

### Java Version

* Java 21 or newer

### Supported Server Software

Officially Supported:

* Paper 1.21.1+

Likely Compatible (not officially tested):

* Purpur
* Spigot
* Folia

### Dependencies

Required:

* None

Optional:

* MySQL server (only when using MYSQL storage mode)

## Storage Notice

### Version 1.0.0

MySQL was required.

### Version 1.0.1 and Later

FILE storage is enabled by default and MySQL is optional.

This allows servers to use Pixel Warp without any database setup while still providing MySQL support for advanced environments.
